house.description: Paid leave call center required to be fully operational on January 1, 2026.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Workforce, Labor, and Economic Development Finance and Policy

latest_action.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Workforce, Labor, and Economic Development Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to employment; paid leave; requiring paid leave call center to be fully operational on January 1, 2026.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+MINNESOTA PAID LEAVE DAY ONE CALL CENTER OPERATIONS. +]

[+The commissioner of employment and economic development must ensure that call center operations for the Minnesota paid leave program are fully operational on January 1, 2026, to provide customer service on day one of implementation of the program. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to employment; paid leave; requiring paid leave call center to be fully operational on January 1, 2026.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. MINNESOTA PAID LEAVE DAY ONE CALL CENTER OPERATIONS.

The commissioner of employment and economic development must ensure that call center operations for the Minnesota paid leave program are fully operational on January 1, 2026, to provide customer service on day one of implementation of the program.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
